classification: Wash local binding decision for selected F15 output policy; not a recovered DEE provider ABI

roles.prepared_job_input: Binds programme, selected input resource/config/ADM and positive N. It is input preparation only and cannot mint output-provider authority.
roles.validated_encoding_plan: Trusted programme-parent value created only after exact six-dimensional EncodingProfile resolution, validation of selected codec/JOC/F13/F14 provider identities, selected carriage mode, and join to the same PreparedJobInput programme/resource/config/N.
roles.f15_dependency_manifest: Approved package-bound dependency manifest, not itself a runtime OutputProvider JSON. Its exact SHA is included in the plan-derived publication provider projection.
roles.output_provider: F15 filesystem/publication policy projection derived privately from ValidatedEncodingPlan. Its profile_id is an F15 namespace, distinct from the GTC codec profile_id. It is not caller-selectable.
roles.output_provider_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact canonical UTF-8 provider object bytes recorded below; carried by OutputConfiguration/OutputOwner and compared with the plan-derived value before staging.

authoritative_producer.owner: Trusted encoding programme parent after validated plan formation
inputs: same PreparedJobInput identity: ProgrammeId, resource SHA, config SHA and N
validated selected stage/provider receipts and carriage mode
authoritative_producer.operation: A private plan method derives the exact F15 provider projection. The output binding constructor accepts the validated plan plus typed AttemptId, distinct opaque OutputStagingOwnerId and destination; it creates OutputProvider internally. Do not expose a production API accepting arbitrary OutputProvider or arbitrary provider_sha256.
authoritative_producer.status: This contract defines the producer; it does not claim the current Rust constructor/caller has been changed or executed.

profile_binding.dimensions: Use the existing six-dimension EncodingProfile and resolve_selected_profile; no shortened profile inferred from frame size.
profile_binding.carriage: Must be the exact selected EncodingProfile carriage value: deployed_compat default or explicitly selected etsi_emdf. The plan projection and output-provider SHA bind it.
profile_binding.namespace_rule: The F15 output-policy profile id and GTC codec profile id name distinct contracts. The trusted plan binds both; they are not compared for literal equality.

selected_output_provider_projection.templates: Wash local deterministic filename policy, not native algorithm behavior. Expand inside the parent-reserved opaque staging namespace; that namespace and final destination are bound separately.

dynamic_counts.rule: These are plan-derived runtime values; no single-song constants are provider fields or hash inputs.

pre_io_rejections: No validated encoding plan or plan not bound to current PreparedJobInput ProgrammeId/resource SHA/config SHA/N.
EncodingProfile is not the exact supported six-dimensional row or carriage is unsupported.
F15 dependency manifest identity differs from the approved package-bound identity or a required provider/stage receipt is absent/mismatched.
Caller-supplied OutputProvider/provider SHA differs from the plan-derived canonical projection; production constructor should not accept an independent provider argument.
AttemptId, programme identity, opaque staging owner, output namespace or destination is stale or cross-bound.
Dynamic source/AU/product-length arithmetic overflows or conflicts with the validated plan.
attempt_and_owner: Use OUTPUT-ATTEMPT-IDENTITY-BINDING-V1: same typed U64 AttemptId as GTC; canonical decimal string derived internally. Opaque staging owner remains a distinct parent-owned identity. Equal attempt values from different programmes do not establish owner identity.
publication_boundary: Existing F15/GTC source and finalize proposals consume this provider-bound plan. Durable append/readback/fsync receipts and final exposure remain under existing shell/parent rules; this provider decision does not claim filesystem or whole-programme execution.
fixture_boundary: OUTPUT-OWNER-ROOT-V1 is test-only with production_allowed=false. Its runtime receipt and filesystem evidence are not promoted. This Wash decision defines a new local plan-bound provider projection from approved F15 semantics.
